mapper.insert: INSERT INTO `b_assess_category` (gmt_create, service_assess_category_id, service_assess_id, service_order_id) VALUES (now(), #{serviceAssessCategoryId}, #{serviceAssessId}, #{serviceOrderId})
mapper.update: update `b_service_assess` set name = #{name} , gmt_modify = now() where id = #{id};
update `b_service_assess` set is_delete = true , gmt_modify = now() where id = #{id};
update `b_service_category` set name = #{name}, fix_price = #{fixPrice} where id = #{id};
mapper.select: select id,name,service_id as serviceId from `b_service_assess` where id = #{id} and is_delete = false;
select id,name,service_id AS serviceId from `b_service_assess` where service_id = #{serviceId} and is_delete = false;
select id,name,fix_price as fixPrice from `b_service_category` where is_delete = false LIMIT #{offset}, #{rows};

SELECT bac.name name, bac.id id, bac.fix_price fixPrice FROM b_service_category bac LEFT JOIN b_assess_category bsc ON bsc.service_assess_category_id = bac.id where bac.is_delete = 0
and bsc.service_order_id = #{serviceOrderId}
